format:
<audio id="gasAlarm" loop>
<source src="https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/alarms/alarm_clock.ogg" type="audio/ogg">
</audio>

<script>
const alarm = document.getElementById("gasAlarm");

this.$watch('msg', function(msg) {

if (!msg) return;

if (msg.payload === "WARNING" || msg.payload === "DANGER"){

alarm.play().catch(() => {});

} else {

alarm.pause();
alarm.currentTime = 0;

}

});
</script>
